title: Voice in a dream urges him to speak
summary: Kiran Ilum Xenov tells of Voice in a dream urges him to speak, about 1997 at Unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: one night while I was sleeping I heard, "What are you afraid of? Why aren't you speaking? You met with us, didn't you?"

plain: Kiran Ilum Xenov, introduced on Jesse Michels's podcast as a former president of a republic within Russia, says that in 1997 a voice spoke to him one night while he slept. It asked, "What are you afraid of? Why aren't you speaking? You met with us, didn't you?" He tells it as the push to speak openly about the beings he says he met, which would mean they wanted their contact with him made public.
